competitiveTarget: City-d restyle of the live /cities/[slug] template: photo hero, pitch, nearby named places, Chart Room Time/Relate/Rank, assigned schools, reviews, walk closer. Spark/MLS counts, place graph, and SEO H1 stay live.
note: Visual restyle of the existing city template only. One template by slug. No invented cities, counts, parks, or HOA dollars. Hero crumb is names only (Places is not a URL). No chips, no mid-page Ask me, no broker photos.
